evidence: Workbook #53 (Quality Checks/Internal row 54): 'reads as authored for this product, fits the suite's domain plan, and isn't a nouns-swapped clone of a sibling'; skill quality-checks.md:212-214 'Compare against sibling task names and concepts. Defect: a nouns-swapped clone of a sibling - same flows, same criteria, renamed entities.' AUTHORED FOR THIS PRODUCT: task.toml name 'turing/hireops-recruiting-operations', arena_slice 'recruiting-hiring-operations', description and difficulty_explanation describe exactly the brief's two axes (shared pipeline board + recruiter-candidate conversations under concurrency). instruction.md is a HireOps-specific request (board one-stage moves, interview places, who-changed-it refusal, all-or-none multi-move, undo, 15 s live updates preserving typing/focus/scroll, paged conversations, per-person unread/seen, per-user drafts surviving sign-out, candidate redaction). hireops_rules.md sections 1-9 give product-specific rules (role table, candidate wording table Applied->'Application received'... Rejected->'Not moving forward', reopen-to-rejected-from-stage, undo invalidation rules, page size 30). Seed is product-specific (jobs Platform Engineer/Infrastructure, Data Analyst/Finance Systems, Product Designer/Design; 120-message Noor conversation; read markers; generated_note references hireops_rules.md). All 16 functional criteria (hro_intake_restart ... hro_candidate), 5 polish (hro_pol_live_board, _live_thread, _earlier_place, _failed_send, _session_resume) and 5 visual rows (hro_vis_*, anchors naming board/conversations/rejected stage) are authored around HireOps accounts and flows. Grep of the frozen task for foreign product names (Pellmoor, vacancy, BazaarBridge, Docketlight, TorqueBay, Colderwater, Ridgeline, Threadline, GridForge, PatchPad, Boardloom, Northstar) and CHANGE_ME found none (only CSS 'grid-template' and 'prompt_template' keys). Template cmp: only template-controlled harness files are identical (test.sh, score.py, scoring.toml, Dockerfiles), as required; every prompt/criterion/app_context file differs from the template. NOT A NOUNS-SWAPPED CLONE: closest sibling is projects/pellmoor-job-pipeline (also recruiting; arena_slice 'full-stack-typescript-d3-esbuild-express-sqlite-pipeline'). Shared domain basics (five-stage pipeline, no skipping, one-step back, no duplicate person per job/vacancy, stale-revision refusal) are inherent to recruiting, but the mechanics differ: Pellmoor centres on interview panels and 1-5 scores, assessments invalidated by panel change, offer-opening capacity (offer+hired <= openings), reviewed batch offers, durable actor-scoped retry receipts and a d3 funnel, and treats Rejected as terminal (hiring-rules.md:1-12, 49-60). HireOps has none of panels/scores/funnel/receipts; instead it has reopenable rejections to the rejected-from stage, Interview-place capacity, manual in-stage ordering, personal undo with touch-invalidation, live multi-user updates, and a full conversation subsystem (paging, unread, seen, drafts, candidate portal with redaction) absent from Pellmoor (grep of Pellmoor rules/instruction for unread/conversation/draft/message found none; its single 'undo' at line 66 concerns capacity release). Criterion id sets share no ids or flows one-to-one. threadline-chat (Slack-style channels/threads/reactions/pins/webhooks) is messaging but not recruiting and has no board or candidate portal. DOMAIN PLAN: no explicit suite domain-plan document was found in the workspace (grep for 'domain plan'/'suite plan'); NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md:203 requires 'author distinct domain behavior. Do not make nouns-swapped clones', which HireOps satisfies; task.toml provenance 'Adapted from the supplied HireOps task as a recruiting workspace' and a unique arena_slice indicate it is an assigned slice rather than a duplicate. COLDERWATER LESSONS checked for this row: lesson 5's 'check it yourself' line is reused but rewritten around HireOps actions (sign in as two of us, move and reject cards, move several and undo, send messages, reload); lesson 8's modifier-click wording in app_context is shared harness guidance, not a cloned product flow; no other lesson (1-21) bears on distinctness/authorship, and no instance of copied sibling criteria or renamed entities was found. Counterexample search: a broken or conforming app cannot change this row's outcome (it concerns task authorship, not grading); the plausible failure mode - a renamed copy of Pellmoor or of a template - was tested directly and refuted above. No runtime evidence is needed for this row.
